verdict.rationale: Brevo ships AI features (Aura AI, AI copy drafting, MCP integration), so the question of whether customer data can be excluded from AI model training applies to it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or any no-training commitment. The IP whitelisting and security-incident items are about a different topic and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
